title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ra

translated_title: 深度增长与循环如何塑造语言模型中的上下文学习
translated_abstract: 循环与深度增长语言模型通过在深度方向上复用计算，并因其推理能力而受到关注。基于先前关于上下文学习增强的提示性证据，我们研究了这种复用如何有利于上下文学习，包括它如何塑造该能力的获取、保持及内在机制。我们的分析涵盖高达30亿参数的预训练语言模型以及受控任务。实验为一种共享的、偏向于从上下文学习的归纳偏置提供了证据：深度增长和循环模型更依赖上下文中的信息，与全深度稠密参考模型相比，它们在受控任务中更早获得上下文学习能力，并且即使在权重中学习固定关联也成为可能的情况下，仍能更强地保持这种能力。通过追踪训练过程中的注意力头，我们发现深度增长会将早期形成的归纳头传播到各个层。消融实验表明，深度增长和循环模型对归纳……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 深度增长与循环语言模型通过跨层复用计算形成了偏向从上下文学习的归纳偏置，使其比稠密模型更早获得且更强保持上下文学习能力，其机制在于深度增长将早期归纳头传播到各层。
en_tdlr: Depth-grown and looped language models share an inductive bias toward learning from context, acquiring and retaining in-context learning earlier and more robustly than dense models, because depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers.
